questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow merging traffic to enter your lane safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns that traffic violations in work zones carry higher penalties. Drive carefully and follow all rules in construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When you are on a multi-lane road, move to another lane if it is safe to do so to make room for entering traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if needed to avoid a collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down and watch for trains. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign tells you that road work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that parking in this area is not allowed. Your vehicle will be towed if you park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for horse-drawn buggies ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns you of a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people in the crosswalk and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of multiple curves ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane will leave the highway. Change lanes to continue on the highway, or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means a traffic light is coming up. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road makes a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means drivers in the left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way traffic. You cannot enter from your current direction.
